sentences.text: Sometimes only one landmark is in sight.
A running fix uses it twice.
Take a bearing and plot the line of position.
Keep running on a steady course and speed, and later take a second bearing on the same or another object.
Then advance the first L O P: move it parallel to itself, in the direction of your course, by the distance you ran between bearings.
Where the advanced line crosses the second L O P is your running fix.
Its accuracy depends on your course and speed being right, so unknown current between bearings creates error.
